name: Shirley Boho Bag
description: Shirley is a quilted multi colored and multi accented bag. Made by me. She measures 22” wide 13.5” high and a 4” box bottom. She has pockets on the back and inside. A long zipper closure. Shirley is adorned with crystal dangles, evergreen pompoms, doily lace in angel wings, bridal satin ribbon in sage, and a double sided Aztec print strap. Very ADIRONDACK CHIC! Comfortable to wear and gorgeous to look at. Shirley is a beautiful bag and is named after my friend in heaven 😇 and there’s only ONE!!!
